job.title: Distribution Sales Consultant
job.description:
Distribution Sales Consultant – Industrial Automation

Perth, WA

Full-Time | Home-Based / Remote

About the Company

My client is a well-established global supplier of industrial automation technology, providing pneumatic and electrical automation solutions to customers across manufacturing, engineering and process industries.

The business offers a broad range of automation products and technical solutions through an established distribution network, supporting industrial customers across Australia.

The Role

My client is seeking an experienced Distribution Sales Consultant to manage and develop its distribution network across Western Australia.

Based from a home office in Perth, you will be responsible for maintaining existing distributor relationships, identifying new distribution partners and supporting sales growth across the industrial automation market.

The role involves regular distributor visits, joint customer meetings, account planning and working closely with internal teams to support distributor performance and achieve sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop relationships with existing distribution partners.
  • Identify and establish new distributor relationships to increase market coverage.
  • Develop and implement account plans and joint business plans with distribution partners.
  • Drive sales growth and achieve agreed sales targets across the assigned territory.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify opportunities across different industries and geographical areas.
  • Support distributors with product knowledge, technical applications and sales opportunities.
  • Conduct regular distributor visits and joint customer meetings.
  • Work with distribution partners to improve product positioning and increase market presence.
  • Implement channel sales strategies covering pricing, stock management, product sales and distributor development.
  • Coordinate with internal sales teams to manage channel relationships and resolve potential conflicts.
  • Monitor distributor performance and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Maintain accurate sales activities, customer information and opportunities within CRM systems.

About You

To be considered for this position, you will ideally have:

  • Minimum 5 years of professional sales experience, preferably within industrial automation or related technical products.
  • Tertiary qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Technology, Business Administration or a comparable discipline.
  • Strong technical knowledge of industrial automation products, applications and processes.
  • Previous experience managing distributors, channel partners or industrial sales accounts.
  • Established customer or stakeholder relationships within the industrial automation industry.
  • Good understanding of distributor business models, sales processes and commercial requirements.
  • Experience developing account plans, identifying new business opportunities and achieving sales targets.
  • Ability to discuss technical products and applications with distributors and customers.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage a territory and organise customer visits.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, and CRM systems.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience selling pneumatic, electrical automation or process control products.
  • Existing relationships with industrial automation distributors across Western Australia.
  • Knowledge of pneumatic components, electric actuators, motion control and related automation technologies.
  • Experience developing and expanding distributor networks.
  • Background working with automation manufacturers, suppliers or industrial distributors.
  • Experience conducting joint customer visits and supporting distributor sales teams.

What's on Offer

  • Full-time opportunity with an established global automation business.
  • Home-based working arrangement in Perth.
  • Competitive salary package with sales incentives.
  • Car allowance and business expenses.
  • Laptop and mobile phone provided.
  • Home office setup support, if required.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Career development opportunities within an international organisation.

job.title: Account Relationship Manager
job.description:
Account Manager – Industrial Chemicals

Sydney, NSW | Greater Sydney territory

Turn your chemistry knowledge into a customer-facing career. Manage an established portfolio of industrial customers, recommend raw materials and work with technical teams to take formulations from lab trial to commercial supply. The portfolio spans coatings and construction chemicals, with opportunities to grow existing accounts and win new business.

What you’ll bring

  • Ideally a degree in Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, or a Bachelor of Science or Applied Science in a related discipline.
  • The ability to understand a customer’s technical requirements and explain how raw materials can improve product performance.

Two backgrounds are welcome

  • Technical sales and account management. You have around 2–5 years’ experience in technical sales, account management or business development in industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals or raw material distribution.
  • Laboratory and formulation. You’re a formulation chemist, lab chemist, development chemist or technical specialist with hands-on experience in formulation, product development or applications testing. You’re ready to move into a commercial role, spend time with customers and develop your sales skills.

Polymer backgrounds are welcome, along with experience in paints and coatings, construction chemicals, adhesives, sealants, resins, additives or related industrial materials.

Apply or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Key Account Manager Channel Sales - MEL
job.description:
Key Account Manager – Indirect Channel / Distribution

Location: Melbourne, VIC

Territory: Victoria, Tasmania and South Australia

A global industrial automation and pneumatics manufacturer is seeking a Key Account Manager to grow its business through an established distributor network. This is a channel management role suited to someone who knows how to help another business sell their products successfully.

You’ll strengthen existing partnerships, increase sales through the channel and identify new distributors that can expand market coverage. Success will come from understanding each partner’s business, earning their trust and making your products a priority for their team.

The role

  • Build commercial relationships with established and regional distributors.
  • Develop account plans that increase sales and share of each partner’s activity.
  • Identify, onboard and develop new distribution partners.
  • Run product training and lunch-and-learn sessions.
  • Join distributor sales teams on customer calls and support opportunities, tenders and projects.
  • Plan regional activities that build product knowledge and engagement across the network.
  • Draw on Melbourne-based Application Engineers for specialist technical support when needed.

Regional and interstate travel is part of the role, particularly while establishing relationships. Visits will be planned around a clear commercial purpose, with virtual contact used where appropriate.

About you

You’ll bring proven experience managing and growing distributor or indirect sales relationships. Your title might be Channel Manager, Distribution Manager, Partner Manager, Business Development Manager, Sales Engineer or Territory Manager; what matters is the work you’ve done through the channel.

You’ll understand the difference between selling directly to an end user and influencing a distributor to actively grow a product range. Strong commercial judgement, relationship-building skills and the ability to lead through influence will be essential.

Industrial automation, pneumatics or a related technical product background would be valuable. You do not need to be the ultimate product expert; technical support is available, and the ability to develop a productive distributor network is central to this role.

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering or trade background highly regarded
  • Open to Automotive mechanics, or spare parts backgrounds, seeking a move into an industrial sales role, with a leading manufacturer. A great platform to establish a career in the industry
  • Mechanical aptitude
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to manage a territory independently.
